title: Three Infinite Classes of APN Permutations on $Z_n$
summary: For any permutation of a nontrivial finite abelian group, the differential uniformity is at least two; permutations attaining this bound are called almost perfect nonlinear (APN). We construct three infinite classes of APN permutations on the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_n$ using Singer cycles, binomials inducing projective permutations, and completed reciprocals combined with parity and quadratic characters.
